lines.text: Your community has opinions. NVDA or gold? Tesla? Let them decide.
On the canvas, open the holders node, and switch the reward to Community Vote. One click.
A vote opens on your public page. Holders sign, no gas. Their weight follows balance and loyalty.
Nobody buys a vote. A wallet that bought yesterday weighs less than one that held a month.
At the closing bell, the winner becomes the dividend. Fees convert with the fair-price guard, and everyone is paid in what they chose.
Next cycle, new vote. Your holders run the dividend policy with you.
Let them vote. yo dash yo dot dev.
